blocks.text: Condo buildings in Sardis South

Its headline finding is a tenure finding: the verified freehold apartment-condo count for Sardis South is ZERO. The area's two named apartment buildings — Skynest (Watson Road) and The Yearling (Chilliwack River Road) — are both First Nations leasehold, and its other apartment product is purpose-built rental or manufactured-home park stock; all are documented below as excluded, with reasons.
Streets, schools and getting around Sardis South

items.t: "Sardis South" is an MLS® sub-area name in the City of Chilliwack; the City publishes no boundary for it.

Plan frame: Sardis South sits inside the Schedule B5 Sardis Neighbourhood Plan area of the 2050 OCP (Bylaw 2025, No. 5500); the Agricultural Plan is Schedule B1 of the same bylaw and Schedule D is the Development Permit Areas schedule.

Where the apartment stock actually sits: two leasehold buildings — Skynest at the Watson Road / Vedder Road corner (45745 and 45757 Watson Road) and The Yearling in the Iron Horse community (6045 Chilliwack River Road) — plus a purpose-built rental building on Vedder Road (McGill Apartments).
The guide page prints "G.W. SD33 catchments are address-based and no locator run for a Sardis South address is on record, so catchments for any specific address are UNVERIFIED.

items.t: Manufactured home parks (MHPTA): where pad-rent parks are discussed (the Unsworth Road park stock), the Manufactured Home Park Tenancy Act rent increase limit for manufactured home site tenancies is 2.3% plus a proportional amount for 2026 and 2.2% plus a proportional amount for 2027.

blocks.text: Good to know about Sardis South

items.t: Sardis South's "condo market" is a leasehold market. Both of its modern apartment buildings stand on Tzeachten First Nations land (Skynest at Watson/Vedder, The Yearling at Iron Horse) — the buildings are new (2022–2024), the amenities are real, and the tenure is leasehold in both cases, so every freehold assumption (Form B, depreciation report, PTT/GST treatment, lender terms) has to be re-derived from the lease documents.

The Yearling is marketed two ways at once. The developer sells its 86 condos as ownership product while a rental platform markets units in the same building to tenants, noting the Residential Tenancy Act does not apply on Tzeachten land — an investor reading only the sales material will miss the tenancy frame entirely.
A 45+ label here is not a strata bylaw. Skynest's 45+ and Promontory Lake Estates' 45+ positions live in lease/park documents, where BC's strata rule (only 55+ is lawful, SPA ss.
Flood diligence is a Vedder-side question, not a page claim. Southern Sardis sits toward the Vedder River side of the city; the Floodplain Regulation Bylaw 2018, No.

The Sardis Sports Complex / Sardis Library pair anchors this sub-area, not Sardis West Vedder. Both facilities (5725 and 5819 Tyson Road) are in Sardis South, a placement the neighbouring guide page itself records — "walk to the rink/library" claims for west-side product should be measured, not assumed.

faq.q: Who can help me buy or sell in Sardis South?
faq.a: Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, works across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361 or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out which school serves an address in Sardis South?
faq.a: School catchments are set by address, so use the school district's catchment locator with the exact address. Catchment lines change, so check before you write an offer.

faq.q: Do I need a home inspection when buying in Sardis South?
faq.a: It is strongly recommended. Make the offer subject to an inspection so a qualified inspector can look at the roof, structure, drainage, electrical and heating before you remove conditions.

faq.q: Can Jared show me homes in Sardis South?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: Are there any freehold condos in Sardis South?
faq.a: The area's apartment buildings — Skynest (45745/45757 Watson Road) and The Yearling (6045 Chilliwack River Road) — are First Nations leasehold, McGill Apartments (5545 Vedder Road) is rental, and the remaining attached stock verified here is townhomes (Higginson Villas, Wealick Place) and manufactured-home park homes.

faq.q: Skynest looks like a normal condo — what is different?
faq.a: The title. Listings record Title To Land: First Nations Lease, the legal sits within Tzeachten IR lands, and there is no Form B, no strata plan ownership and no depreciation-report regime of the freehold kind — the lease term, the community rules and the developer's documents govern, and lenders treat it differently. It is a real, modern building (Phases built 2022 and 2023, 45+ per the developer's marketing) — it is simply not freehold strata stock.

faq.q: Is there a median price for Sardis South condos?
faq.a: No. Chilliwack is not covered by SnapStats and CADREB publishes no sub-area statistics — no median, sales ratio or inventory figure for this sub-area exists in the sources used, and none is stated here.

faq.q: Can I rent out a Skynest or Yearling unit?
faq.a: UNCONFIRMED from strata law — the November 24, 2022 voiding of rental bylaws is a Strata Property Act rule, and these are leasehold communities whose own documents govern rentals (a Skynest MLS sheet records "rentals allowed w/restrictions" as a document term). Read the lease and community rules for the specific unit before valuing any rental income.

faq.q: Which schools serve a Sardis South address?
faq.a: Ministry-confirmed schools on this side include Tyson Elementary (45170 S Sumas Rd), Watson Elementary (45305 Watson Rd), Mount Slesse Middle School (5871 Tyson Rd), Vedder Middle School (45560 South Sumas Rd), Sardis Secondary (45460 Stevenson Rd) and GW Graham Secondary (45955 Thomas Rd) — but SD33 catchments are address-based and no locator result for a Sardis South address is on record, so run the exact address in the SD33 School Locator.

faq.q: Are there townhouses in Sardis South?
faq.a: Buyers can still buy into them — proceed with full Form B/title diligence.

faq.q: Skynest looks like a normal condo — what is different?
faq.a: The title: First Nations Lease within Tzeachten IR lands — no Form B, no strata-plan ownership; the lease term and community rules govern, and lenders treat it differently.

faq.q: What is The Grove on McLaren Drive?
faq.a: A townhouse complex at 44523 McLaren Drive — fresh listings record Sub-Type Townhouse, built 2007, Title to Land Freehold Strata, labelled Sardis South.
